statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), n < m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => (t.1+t.2)%m=n)).card = W A B n + W A B (n+m)

plain_statement.zh: 模图的两步路径精确分成无进位与进位两层
plain_statement.en: Split modular two-step paths into two exact carry layers

brief.zh: 用 a+b<2m 列出两个可能的整数终点，再划分有序路径。后续估计必须扣除第二层。
brief.en: Use a+b<2m to partition ordered paths by their two possible integer endpoints.
